<template>
  <el-dialog
      v-model="dialogVisible"
      title="计划详情"
      width="800px"
      @close="plans = []"
  >
    <!-- 表格展示 -->
    <el-table :data="plans" style="width: 100%">
      <!-- 操作按钮列 -->
      <el-table-column label="操作" width="100" fixed="right">
        <template #default="{ row }">
          <el-button size="small" type="success" @click="executePlan(row.id)">执行</el-button>
        </template>
      </el-table-column>

      <!-- 索引列 -->
      <el-table-column label="#" type="index" width="50" />

      <!-- 动态表头 -->
      <el-table-column label="ID" prop="id" />
      <el-table-column label="名称" prop="name" />
      <el-table-column label="描述" prop="description" />
      <el-table-column label="类型" prop="type" />
      <el-table-column label="大小" prop="size" />
      <el-table-column label="时间" prop="time" />
      <el-table-column label="数量" prop="num" />
      <el-table-column label="速度" prop="velocity" />
      <el-table-column label="容器1" prop="container1" />
      <el-table-column label="容器2" prop="container2" />
      <el-table-column label="容器2 IP" prop="container2Ip" />
    </el-table>

    <template #footer>
      <el-button @click="dialogVisible = false">关闭</el-button>
    </template>
  </el-dialog>
</template>

<script setup>
import { ref, defineExpose } from 'vue'
import axios from 'axios'
import { ElMessage } from 'element-plus'

const dialogVisible = ref(false)
const plans = ref([])

// 打开弹窗并初始化计划数据
const openDialog = async () => {
  dialogVisible.value = true
  try {
    const response = await axios.get('http://localhost:8081/plan/list')
    plans.value = response.data.records || []
  } catch (error) {
    ElMessage.error('获取计划数据失败')
    console.error(error)
  }
}
defineExpose({ openDialog })

// 执行计划
const executePlan = async (planId) => {
  try {
    const response = await axios.post(`http://localhost:8081/plan/execute/${planId}`)
    ElMessage.success(`计划ID ${planId} 执行成功：${response.data}`)
  } catch (err) {
    ElMessage.error(`执行计划失败：${err?.response?.data || err.message}`)
  }
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.el-table th {
  background-color: #f1f5f9;
  color: #333;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.el-button {
  transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

.el-button:hover {
  background-color: #34d399;
}
</style>
